_comment: Bandit camps and monster lairs (PLAN.md §7.5). Hours are game hours (divided by world speed). When a wave ends, spawn.perWave camps of its front appear near its road (within spawn.nearRoad hexes, at least spawn.minVillageDistance from any village), up to spawn.max active camps per front; monster camps are lairs. A camp starts with baseUnits × growthPerWave^waveIndex units of its front's roster and grows by growth.share every growth.everyHours, up to growth.maxUnits. When a wave of its front sets out, a camp sends feed.share of its units with it. Armies clear camps (orders 'clear'): the fight is resolved on arrival, round by round, with the camp fighting from behind its palisade (home bonus, assault.stance). Clearing gives loot.perUnit resources for every camp unit, carried home by the army, a gear drop chance for a hero leading it, and for lairs an emberChance of Svarog's Ember for the group. Caravans passing within ambush.reach of a camp are ambushed: unless their escort's attack reaches ambush.escortRatio × the camp's, they lose ambush.cargoShare of their load and the escort ambush.escortLoss of its troops. When a run starts, every village gets a small bandit camp of starter.units within starter.minDistance-starter.maxDistance hexes, for the getting-started quest's first camp to clear. A bandit camp or lair a fire reaches (fire can also be set on its hex) burns: between burnt.fleeShare.min and max of its troops (a seeded share) flee at once as a small horde of its front from where it stood on the nearest player village, and its front's hatred rises by burnt.hatred (horde.json); the rest perish in the flames.
